limitations: No external 3D models, photographs, trademarks, recorded gunshots, manufacturing diagrams or dimensions are bundled.
The game uses primitive low-poly art, procedural animation, synthesized sound and authored gameplay statistics.
The additional workshop modules are virtual variants. Their real-world branded compatibility has not been verified and is not claimed.
RPK bipod remains folded visual geometry; there is no deployable bipod mechanic.
M14 is intentionally configured for single fire in game. AUG automatic fire uses the existing fire-mode selector rather than reproducing a progressive physical trigger.
Source presence in a manufacturer's catalogue is not evidence of popularity or a ranked 2026 trend.
